answer: What survives to the delta is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the shale of a task receipt, and the garden is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
